semanticPolicy: Scan exact SCN3 dispatcher calls for operation 0x006c.
Convert constant runtime words to little-endian DTPK commands.
Join commands to F1 location banks named by that MAPINFO.
Separately join commands to SYSTEM1 only after proving one source-identical bank is present on all three discs.
Retain runtime commands, ambiguous matches, and commands absent from both proven scopes as unresolved.
Treat object tags in the same generated function as candidates, not semantic mappings.
